name: duration_hms1.k
model:
class VideoClip {
  length:Duration

  req length >= 0:00:00

  req length <= 0:10:00
}

class Movie {
  runtime:Duration

  req runtime >= 1:00:00

  req runtime <= 3:00:00
}

class AudioClip {
  duration:Duration

  req duration >= 0:00:00.000

  req duration <= 0:00:30.500
}

clip1:VideoClip

movie1:Movie

audio1:AudioClip

req clip1.length = 0:05:30

req movie1.runtime = 2:15:00

req audio1.duration = 0:00:15.250
smt:
; ================
; === Options: ===
; ================

(set-option :smt.macro-finder true)

; ======================
; === String Theory: ===
; ======================

; Z3 4.13.0+ requires explicit logic or theory declaration for strings
(set-logic ALL)

; ===========================
; === Built-in datatypes: ===
; ===========================

(define-sort Ref () Int)

(declare-datatypes (T1 T2) ((Tuple2 (mk-Tuple2 (_1 T1)(_2 T2)))))
(declare-datatypes (T1 T2 T3) ((Tuple3 (mk-Tuple3 (_1 T1)(_2 T2)(_3 T3)))))


; ===============================
; === User-defined datatypes: ===
; ===============================

(declare-datatypes () ((TopLevelDeclarations (mk-TopLevelDeclarations (clip1 Ref)(movie1 Ref)(audio1 Ref)))))
(declare-datatypes () ((VideoClip (mk-VideoClip (length Int)))))
(declare-datatypes () ((Movie (mk-Movie (runtime Int)))))
(declare-datatypes () ((AudioClip (mk-AudioClip (duration Int)))))

; =============
; === Heap: ===
; =============

(declare-datatypes () ((Any
  (lift-TopLevelDeclarations (sel-TopLevelDeclarations TopLevelDeclarations))
  (lift-VideoClip (sel-VideoClip VideoClip))
  (lift-Movie (sel-Movie Movie))
  (lift-AudioClip (sel-AudioClip AudioClip))
  null))
)

(declare-const heap (Array Ref Any))
(declare-const NULL$ String)
(declare-const NULL$Ref Ref)
(assert (= NULL$Ref (- 1)))

(define-fun deref ((ref Ref)) Any
  (select heap ref)
)

; ==========================================
; === Class specific is/deref-functions: ===
; ==========================================

(define-fun deref-is-TopLevelDeclarations ((this Ref)) Bool
  (is-lift-TopLevelDeclarations (deref this))
)

(define-fun deref-TopLevelDeclarations ((this Ref)) TopLevelDeclarations
  (sel-TopLevelDeclarations (deref this))
)

(define-fun deref-is-VideoClip ((this Ref)) Bool
  (is-lift-VideoClip (deref this))
)

(define-fun deref-VideoClip ((this Ref)) VideoClip
  (sel-VideoClip (deref this))
)

(define-fun deref-is-Movie ((this Ref)) Bool
  (is-lift-Movie (deref this))
)

(define-fun deref-Movie ((this Ref)) Movie
  (sel-Movie (deref this))
)

(define-fun deref-is-AudioClip ((this Ref)) Bool
  (is-lift-AudioClip (deref this))
)

(define-fun deref-AudioClip ((this Ref)) AudioClip
  (sel-AudioClip (deref this))
)

; ======================
; === Isa-functions: ===
; ======================

(define-fun deref-isa-TopLevelDeclarations ((this Ref)) Bool
  (deref-is-TopLevelDeclarations this)
)

(define-fun deref-isa-VideoClip ((this Ref)) Bool
  (deref-is-VideoClip this)
)

(define-fun deref-isa-Movie ((this Ref)) Bool
  (deref-is-Movie this)
)

(define-fun deref-isa-AudioClip ((this Ref)) Bool
  (deref-is-AudioClip this)
)

; ================
; === Getters: ===
; ================

; -------------------------------------------
;   Getters for class TopLevelDeclarations:
; -------------------------------------------

; --- getters for TopLevelDeclarations.clip1: ---

(define-fun TopLevelDeclarations!clip1 ((this Ref)) Ref
  (clip1 (deref-TopLevelDeclarations this))
)

; --- getters for TopLevelDeclarations.movie1: ---

(define-fun TopLevelDeclarations!movie1 ((this Ref)) Ref
  (movie1 (deref-TopLevelDeclarations this))
)

; --- getters for TopLevelDeclarations.audio1: ---

(define-fun TopLevelDeclarations!audio1 ((this Ref)) Ref
  (audio1 (deref-TopLevelDeclarations this))
)

; --------------------------------
;   Getters for class VideoClip:
; --------------------------------

; --- getters for VideoClip.length: ---

(define-fun VideoClip.length ((this Ref)) Int
  (length (deref-VideoClip this))
)

(define-fun VideoClip!length ((this Ref)) Int
  (length (deref-VideoClip this))
)

; ----------------------------
;   Getters for class Movie:
; ----------------------------

; --- getters for Movie.runtime: ---

(define-fun Movie.runtime ((this Ref)) Int
  (runtime (deref-Movie this))
)

(define-fun Movie!runtime ((this Ref)) Int
  (runtime (deref-Movie this))
)

; --------------------------------
;   Getters for class AudioClip:
; --------------------------------

; --- getters for AudioClip.duration: ---

(define-fun AudioClip.duration ((this Ref)) Int
  (duration (deref-AudioClip this))
)

(define-fun AudioClip!duration ((this Ref)) Int
  (duration (deref-AudioClip this))
)

; ================
; === Methods: ===
; ================

; ===================
; === Invariants: ===
; ===================

; ---------------------------------------------
;   Invariant for class TopLevelDeclarations:
; ---------------------------------------------

; --- Constants: ---

(declare-const const-0-TopLevelDeclarations TopLevelDeclarations)

; --- Invariant 1: ---

(define-fun TopLevelDeclarations.inv1 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (deref-isa-VideoClip (TopLevelDeclarations!clip1 this))
)

(assert (! (TopLevelDeclarations.inv1 0) :named _xkassert0))

; --- Invariant 2: ---

(define-fun TopLevelDeclarations.inv2 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (deref-isa-Movie (TopLevelDeclarations!movie1 this))
)

(assert (! (TopLevelDeclarations.inv2 0) :named _xkassert1))

; --- Invariant 3: ---

(define-fun TopLevelDeclarations.inv3 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (deref-isa-AudioClip (TopLevelDeclarations!audio1 this))
)

(assert (! (TopLevelDeclarations.inv3 0) :named _xkassert2))

; --- Invariant 4: ---

(define-fun TopLevelDeclarations.inv4 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (= (VideoClip.length (TopLevelDeclarations!clip1 this)) 330000000)
)

(assert (! (TopLevelDeclarations.inv4 0) :named _xkassert3))

; --- Invariant 5: ---

(define-fun TopLevelDeclarations.inv5 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (= (Movie.runtime (TopLevelDeclarations!movie1 this)) 8100000000)
)

(assert (! (TopLevelDeclarations.inv5 0) :named _xkassert4))

; --- Invariant 6: ---

(define-fun TopLevelDeclarations.inv6 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (= (AudioClip.duration (TopLevelDeclarations!audio1 this)) 15250000)
)

(assert (! (TopLevelDeclarations.inv6 0) :named _xkassert5))



; ----------------------------------
;   Invariant for class VideoClip:
; ----------------------------------

; --- Constants: ---

(declare-const const-1-VideoClip VideoClip)

; --- Invariant 1: ---

(define-fun VideoClip.inv1 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (>= (VideoClip!length this) 0)
)

(assert (! (VideoClip.inv1 1) :named _xkassert6))

; --- Invariant 2: ---

(define-fun VideoClip.inv2 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (<= (VideoClip!length this) 600000000)
)

(assert (! (VideoClip.inv2 1) :named _xkassert7))



; ------------------------------
;   Invariant for class Movie:
; ------------------------------

; --- Constants: ---

(declare-const const-2-Movie Movie)

; --- Invariant 1: ---

(define-fun Movie.inv1 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (>= (Movie!runtime this) 3600000000)
)

(assert (! (Movie.inv1 2) :named _xkassert8))

; --- Invariant 2: ---

(define-fun Movie.inv2 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (<= (Movie!runtime this) 10800000000)
)

(assert (! (Movie.inv2 2) :named _xkassert9))



; ----------------------------------
;   Invariant for class AudioClip:
; ----------------------------------

; --- Constants: ---

(declare-const const-3-AudioClip AudioClip)

; --- Invariant 1: ---

(define-fun AudioClip.inv1 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (>= (AudioClip!duration this) 0)
)

(assert (! (AudioClip.inv1 3) :named _xkassert10))

; --- Invariant 2: ---

(define-fun AudioClip.inv2 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (<= (AudioClip!duration this) 30500000)
)

(assert (! (AudioClip.inv2 3) :named _xkassert11))




; ======================
; === Generate heap: ===
; ======================

(assert
  (=
    heap
    (store(store(store(store
      ((as const (Array Ref Any)) null)
        0 (lift-TopLevelDeclarations const-0-TopLevelDeclarations))
        1 (lift-VideoClip const-1-VideoClip))
        2 (lift-Movie const-2-Movie))
        3 (lift-AudioClip const-3-AudioClip))
  )
)
smtModel:
(define-fun const-3-AudioClip () AudioClip
  (mk-AudioClip 15250000))
(define-fun const-1-VideoClip () VideoClip
  (mk-VideoClip 330000000))
(define-fun const-2-Movie () Movie
  (mk-Movie 8100000000))
(define-fun const-0-TopLevelDeclarations () TopLevelDeclarations
  (mk-TopLevelDeclarations 1 2 3))
(define-fun _xkassert7 () Bool
  (<= (length (sel-VideoClip (select heap 1))) 600000000))
(define-fun _xkassert2 () Bool
  (let ((a!1 (select heap (audio1 (sel-TopLevelDeclarations (select heap 0))))))
  (is-lift-AudioClip a!1)))
(define-fun _xkassert5 () Bool
  (let ((a!1 (select heap (audio1 (sel-TopLevelDeclarations (select heap 0))))))
  (= (duration (sel-AudioClip a!1)) 15250000)))
(define-fun _xkassert9 () Bool
  (<= (runtime (sel-Movie (select heap 2))) 10800000000))
(define-fun _xkassert0 () Bool
  (let ((a!1 (select heap (clip1 (sel-TopLevelDeclarations (select heap 0))))))
  (is-lift-VideoClip a!1)))
(define-fun _xkassert8 () Bool
  (>= (runtime (sel-Movie (select heap 2))) 3600000000))
(define-fun _xkassert10 () Bool
  (>= (duration (sel-AudioClip (select heap 3))) 0))
(define-fun _xkassert3 () Bool
  (let ((a!1 (select heap (clip1 (sel-TopLevelDeclarations (select heap 0))))))
  (= (length (sel-VideoClip a!1)) 330000000)))
(define-fun _xkassert11 () Bool
  (<= (duration (sel-AudioClip (select heap 3))) 30500000))
(define-fun _xkassert1 () Bool
  (let ((a!1 (select heap (movie1 (sel-TopLevelDeclarations (select heap 0))))))
  (is-lift-Movie a!1)))
(define-fun _xkassert4 () Bool
  (let ((a!1 (select heap (movie1 (sel-TopLevelDeclarations (select heap 0))))))
  (= (runtime (sel-Movie a!1)) 8100000000)))
(define-fun _xkassert6 () Bool
  (>= (length (sel-VideoClip (select heap 1))) 0))
(define-fun NULL$Ref () Int
  (- 1))
(define-fun heap () (Array Int Any)
  (let ((a!1 (store (store ((as const (Array Int Any)) null)
                         0
                         (lift-TopLevelDeclarations
                           (mk-TopLevelDeclarations 1 2 3)))
                  1
                  (lift-VideoClip (mk-VideoClip 330000000)))))
  (store (store a!1 2 (lift-Movie (mk-Movie 8100000000)))
         3
         (lift-AudioClip (mk-AudioClip 15250000)))))
